title: Private Deployments - Weekly Update 2026-08-17
content:
Summary:

This week's focus: customer VPC onboarding, two air-gapped on-prem installs, and production hardening for KMS/HSM integrations. Standups tilted toward unblockers and runbook updates; we ran a dry-run of the air-gapped installer in the lab and hit a few reproducible issues (see blockers).

Major progress:
- VPC onboarding: Completed network walkthrough and peering checklist for Customer A (enterprise-fintech). Networking team signed off on route propagation; we validated cross-account IAM roles for their AWS account. Remaining: final cert rotation test (scheduled 2026-08-19).
- Air-gapped installer dry-run: Installed on two-node lab cluster (k8s v1.26) using airgap bundle v2026-08-12. KV-cache initialization failed intermittently due to missing etcd TLS SAN entries; created PD-3478 and pushed a patch to the installer to add SAN validation.
- KMS/HSM integration: Completed initial integration tests with vendor HSM (GeminiSec HSM) in staging. Key wrapping/unwrapping succeeded, but latency spikes observed under heavy token load — SRE looking into throttling configuration.
- Helm/Chart updates: Merged PR to add optional debug sidecar and expanded liveness/readiness probes (github.com/redwood-inference/helm-charts/pull/456).
- Runbook: Updated "Private Deployments Runbook" page with air-gap preflight checklist and expanded network diagram.

Standup log highlights (daily):
- Mon (2026-08-10): Customer A onboarding kickoff. Identified missing cross-account role policy in their template.
- Tue (2026-08-11): Airgap dry-run #1 — etcd SAN failure observed; reproduced locally.
- Wed (2026-08-12): Patch for installer SAN validation landed; smoke test passed.
- Thu (2026-08-13): KMS/HSM load test — observed 12% error rate at 350 rps; escalated to SRE and vendor.
- Fri (2026-08-14): Customer B (healthcare) preflight — discovered policy requirement for long-lived certs with specific CN pattern; awaiting legal approval for template change.

Blockers & Risks:
- PD-3421 (Customer A): Cert rotation test failing due to intermediate cert chain mismatch (customer CA). Impact: delays final go/no-go. Workaround: manual cert replace script; risk of downtime during rotation. Owner: Liam Chen.
- PD-3478 (Air-gapped installer): etcd TLS SAN validation -> causing KV cache init failure. Patch in testing; risk: any existing airgap bundles missing SAN will fail installs. Owner: Sofia Martinez.
- KMS latency under load: observed spikes that cause token issuance retries. SRE investigating throttling and vendor HSM config; may require async key ops or local caching strategies. Owner: Noah Rivera.
- Customer B legal requirement: long-lived cert CN pattern not currently supported by our cert manager templates; legal & security approval pending. Impact: hold on scheduled on-prem deploy (Customer B). Owner: Priya Gupta.

Action items (this week):
- Aisha: Coordinate Customer A cert rotation window and run cert rotation test with patched CA chain (due 2026-08-19).
- Liam: Prepare manual cert replace runbook and automate verification steps (PD-3421).
- Sofia: Finalize and merge hotfix for installer SAN validation, then publish new airgap bundle (v2026-08-18).
- Noah: Run second KMS load test with throttling config and capture pprof traces; create mitigation proposal (async wrap cache) by 2026-08-21.
- Priya: Follow up with legal on CN pattern approval and write conservative fallback for cert manager templates.
- SRE: Confirm monitoring alerts for HSM latency spike and add a dashboard panel for per-tenant KMS latency by 2026-08-20.

Decisions made:
- Move forward with patched installer for upcoming customer installs; include explicit preflight check for etcd SANs in runbook.
- For KMS/HSM, trial local wrapped-key caching in staging before recommending HSM configuration changes to customers.

Notes from meetings:
- 2026-08-12 Incident review (KMS latency): root cause likely vendor-side IO contention under burst. Vendor to provide firmware micro-patch; meanwhile we will throttle client threads and add retry-backoff.
- 2026-08-14 Customer B preflight sync: customer required extended audit logs; added to backlog with tag "audit-reqs" and prioritized for next sprint.

Next week plan (2026-08-17 -> 2026-08-21):
- Complete airgap bundle publish and run full install for Customer C in staging.
- Cert rotation for Customer A (target 2026-08-19).
- KMS mitigation proposal and second load run.
- Finalize runbook updates and push a "deploy checklist" template for Solutions Engineering to use for customer installs.

Quick TODOs / Notes to self:
- Add example systemd unit for airgap bundle prefetch on installer host.
- Capture network packet logs during Customer A cert test to validate route propagation.
- Remind legal to approve CN pattern (Priya).

Attachments / linked artifacts:
- JIRA: PD-3421 (Customer A cert rotation)
- JIRA: PD-3478 (Airgap installer SAN validation)
- GH PR: helm-charts/pull/456 (sidecar + probes)
- Confluence: Private Deployments Runbook (updated section: Airgap preflight)
- Slack: #private-deployments thread (2026-08-16) for live troubleshooting notes

If anything urgent, escalate in Slack and @Aisha.

-- End of weekly update
